subject: Partner demo credit safeguard checklist and approval
messages:
From: Ananya Rao <ananya@accelerate.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: CloudForge demo credits for Redwood pilot

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. The CloudForge accelerator cohort is excited about building on Redwood and we'd like to provide a demo environment backed by our marketplace credits to speed adoption. Before we issue any promotional credits we need a short checklist from Redwood confirming:

- data handling safeguards for demo workloads (no customer PII retained)
- expiry and usage guardrails
- visibility into token consumption for billing reconciliation

Can you point me to the right contacts and share a short one-page checklist we can attach to the grant? I can loop in procurement if needed.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Ananya Rao
Partnerships Lead, Accelerate Foundation
Ananya@accelerate.org
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Rao <ananya@accelerate.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudForge demo credits for Redwood pilot

Ananya —

Appreciate the context. Quick note: we can accept marketplace-provided promo credits for partner demos but we require a brief safeguard checklist and a signed acknowledgement from the accelerator. I've drafted a short checklist and a usage guidance doc (see attachments) that cover:

- allowed datasets for demo instances (no PII or sensitive customer corp data)
- short-lived keys + automatic revoke after 90 days
- caps on token usage and alerts at 70% of the allocated credits
- telemetry sharing for reconciliation (token-level reports, daily summary)

I've attached a draft "safeguard-checklist.xlsx" and our standard "usage-guidelines.md". If that looks good to you, I can get Legal to add a one-line sign-off and we can route the DocuSign to your procurement team.

Next steps: please confirm the credit amount and expiration window you intend to provision, and whether CloudForge needs Redwood to host the demo in us-west (we can spin a dedicated trial instance) or if you'll link marketplace credits to a partner-managed sandbox.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachments: safeguard-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), usage-guidelines.md (text)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ananya Rao <ananya@accelerate.org>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudForge demo credits for Redwood pilot

Ben / Ananya —

Thanks for the draft, Ben — good starting point. A couple of asks from our side (ops / finance):

1) For accounting we need the grant to include an activation window (suggest 120 days) and a hard token cap tied to the marketplace voucher ID so we can reconcile consumption.
2) Ops prefers that partner-sourced credits route into a partner-dedicated trial instance (us-west) to make autoscaling and KV cache isolation predictable. If CloudForge prefers attaching credits to partner-managed sandboxes, we require exported logs + a weekly token usage report.

I'm attaching a short SOW outline for the cohort that includes the activation window and responsibilities. If Ananya can confirm the voucher ID and whether the marketplace will allow us to revoke or reduce the credit if misuse is detected, Legal will prepare a one-paragraph acknowledgement for CloudForge to sign.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: accelerator_SOW.pdf (draft SOW)

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks — we can do 150k token-equivalent credits, expiring 120 days after activation. Voucher ID: CF-ACCEL-2025-347. CloudForge confirms the marketplace allows revocation under suspected abuse; I'll attach the marketplace terms if you want them.

We prefer Redwood host the partner-dedicated trial in us-west so the cohort gets consistent performance. We'll sign the one-paragraph acknowledgement once Legal has the final text.

Attaching marketplace terms (PDF) and procurement contact for our finance team. Please send the DocuSign link and we'll complete the signature.

Best,
Ananya
Attachments: cloudforge_marketplace_terms.pdf (PDF), cloudforge_procurement_contact.vcf (vCard)
